# Parker Branham

> Personal portfolio of Parker Branham, a high school senior (Class of 2027) at Cardinal Newman
> School in Columbia, South Carolina, planning to study mechatronics engineering. He runs a
> home-hosted Minecraft server network, builds websites, competes in Beta Club robotics and is
> working to start a FIRST Tech Challenge team, does 3D design and printing, stage manages for
> his school's theater, and shoots film and digital photography. He founded SC Pressure Point,
> a student-owned pressure washing business, currently paused.

Site: https://www.parkerbranham.com/
Contact: GitHub https://github.com/OneRedPanda99 · LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/in/parker-branham-9b32a5341/

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.parkerbranham.com/): Bio, project overview, experience, and contact.
- [Theater & Ghost Light](https://www.parkerbranham.com/theater.html): Stage manager at Cardinal Newman, and Ghost Light, a live set-change tracker app he built for the theater crew.
- [Clearline](https://www.parkerbranham.com/clearline.html): An unfinished Firebase-backed CRM built for SC Pressure Point: auth, data model, and security rules.
- [SC Pressure Point](https://www.parkerbranham.com/scpressurepoint.html): Student-owned pressure washing business in Columbia, SC (paused), with published square-foot pricing. Live site: https://scpressurepoint.com
- [Server Administrator](https://www.parkerbranham.com/server.html): Home-hosted Minecraft network with a BungeeCord proxy, custom plugins, a Discord bot, and about 80 members.
- [Robotics](https://www.parkerbranham.com/robotics.html): 4th place at Beta Club Robotics, and an effort to start an FTC team at Cardinal Newman (not yet approved).
- [3D Design & Printing](https://www.parkerbranham.com/printing.html): Fusion 360 CAD work and FDM printing.
- [Photography](https://www.parkerbranham.com/photography.html): Film and digital, shot on a Canon A-1 and a Sony A6400; digital edited from RAW in Photoshop.

## Optional

- [Handwriting plotter (in progress)](https://github.com/OneRedPanda99/OneRedPanda99): A handwriting data collector for training a model to write like him on a pen plotter.
